sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A small tuberous terrestrial orchid widespread across temperate Eurasia to the Himalaya. It is about 5.5–35 cm tall and grows in open grassland, often on calcareous soils.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: Two main leaves sit near the base of the stem. The small spike bears greenish-yellow flowers with a three-lobed lip.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No safe food use is documented; collecting this wild orchid is not recommended.
